name: superstacks
description: Use for planning, TDD, verification, code review, PRs, debugging, design grilling, and ticket pipelines. Lean MIT skill stack for coding agents.

interface.longDescription: Superstacks is a small MIT-licensed set of coding-agent skills: discovery, implementation plans in the pull request body, test-driven development, verification before any success claim, two-axis code review, draft pull requests, optional adversarial review for money-path or schema changes, and design grilling with ADRs. The plugin runs, sends, and fetches nothing.
